rubric_items.reason: Most changed paths are tested, but S-2 AC2 (specialization changed after booking) and S-4 AC2/AC4 (Completed, No-show page unchanged) have no test, even though the artifact says they are covered.
Assertions check exact response shapes and rendered text. The REQ-6 test never checks that the doctor PATCH worked, so it can pass without an Inactive doctor.
Covers 404, Inactive specialization and department on the web, the paise edge and privacy. Inactive department is only tested on the web side.
Uses Vitest+Supertest on the test DB and Testing Library with a MemoryRouter, in the existing places. One test name has no REQ id.
No counts or coverage invented. The artifact defers counts to the verifier, and checks.json shows coverage skipped.

findings.text: The REQ-5 test is said to cover S-2 AC2, but it only changes fee and department. No test changes the specialization after booking and checks Cancelled and No-show appointments show the current one.

cites.quote: the Completed, No-show and Cancelled appointments show the current values (S-2 AC1, AC2)
whose doctor's specialization was changed after booking

findings.suggested_fix: Also change the doctor's specialization (or the specialization name) and assert the Cancelled and No-show details return the new specialization.

findings.text: S-4 is listed as covered, but the web tests only check the Scheduled and Cancelled partitions. Nothing tests that Completed (AC2) and No-show (AC4) pages are unchanged.

cites.quote: S-4: covered by the web Scheduled and Cancelled regression tests and the API list-shape test.
Given a No-show appointment with history entries

findings.suggested_fix: Add web tests for COMPLETED and NO_SHOW appointments that check the history, the closed notice, that no action buttons show, and that the new rows show.

findings.text: The REQ-6 test does not check the doctor PATCH status or that the doctor is Inactive afterwards. If the PATCH fails, the test still passes and proves nothing about Inactive doctors.
findings.suggested_fix: Assert the PATCH returns 200 and the doctor status is INACTIVE before checking the detail.

findings.text: Test naming: the EP-2/EP-4 test name gives no requirement id. The test strategy names tests after the requirement they cover.

cites.quote: HMS-31 (EP-2, EP-4): booking and cancelling answer with the same doctor details
Every PRD requirement has at least one test whose name starts with its ID

findings.suggested_fix: Name it after the requirement it supports, for example HMS-31 REQ-1/REQ-3 (EP-2, EP-4).

cites.quote: API tests use Vitest and Supertest against a throwaway PostgreSQL 16 with a fixed clock
New requirements get new IDs and tests.
The verifier skips coverage (the project has no coverage script)
